scenario.description: A loan portfolio manager must decide whether to grant a temporary DSCR covenant waiver to a borrower and finalize the reserve, fee, and distribution restrictions attached to the waiver, with input from credit risk and loan documentation.

shared_context.S1: The borrower has requested relief from its 1.20 minimum debt-service coverage ratio for the current quarter.
shared_context.S2: The borrower's submitted quarterly figures show a DSCR of 1.08.
shared_context.S3: The borrower has continued making scheduled principal and interest payments on time.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding decision on the waiver and its amendment terms.
shared_context.S5: Under the bank's weekly waiver-review routine, Elena records a risk review and a documentation review before issuing any binding amendment, and she asks the credit risk and documentation reviewers to state their findings during the review.
shared_context.S6: The bank's waiver-amendment template records every risk-policy condition both in the corresponding decision term and as a separate commitment entry; a debt-service reserve is recorded as a condition_imposed commitment targeting the borrower, with the reserve amount and purpose stated in the commitment detail. Elena may settle once the risk-review and documentation-review findings have been disclosed.
shared_context.S7: Bank policy requires each reviewer to formally document the findings of their assigned review in the waiver record before Elena issues the binding amendment.

PF1.text: While reviewing the file this morning, Ravi confirmed that a permitted one-time restructuring charge changes the covenant calculation to an adjusted DSCR of 1.14, and the risk policy allows a 45-day waiver at that level only when a $750,000 debt-service reserve is maintained; his worksheet has not yet been uploaded to the credit file.

PF2.text: Marta received the borrower's signed counsel markup this afternoon, not yet attached to the amendment folder, accepting a 0.75% waiver fee and a prohibition on shareholder distributions during the waiver period.

acceptance_conditions: The DSCR covenant waiver must be approved for exactly 45 days.
The borrower must maintain a debt-service reserve of exactly $750,000 as an amendment condition.
The amendment must charge a waiver fee of exactly 0.75%.
Shareholder distributions must be prohibited during the waiver period.
The settlement must include a condition_imposed commitment targeting the borrower whose detail contains $750,000.
The settlement must include the distribution prohibition in its decision terms.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'condition_imposed' and c['target'] == 'borrower' and '$750,000' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The reported 1.08 DSCR alone gives no basis for approval or a specific duration; PF1 changes the calculation to 1.14, sets the permitted waiver duration to exactly 45 days, changes the reserve condition to exactly $750,000, and requires that amount to appear both in debt_service_reserve_usd and in a separate condition_imposed borrower commitment.

The existing request contains no settled amendment economics or distribution restriction; PF2 changes the waiver fee to exactly 0.75% and changes shareholder_distributions_allowed from the unrestricted default to false.
